name: spec
description: Full project lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis-architect → /spec:genesis-explore's fresh-UX-research candidate funnel and design pick → /spec:genesis-design ratifying the winner's tokens-as-code) → roadmap briefs with declared surfaces → per-brief /spec:sketch workbench (mock + brainstorm one brief, ratify before planning) → plan → mock-always design (local responsive HTML mocks under a render-critique harness covering the declared theme×viewport matrix; Claude Design demoted to escape hatch) → build → review → per-milestone /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas (the deterministic whole-product design view: journey graph, gap cards, annotation loop), with deterministic workflows, a hook-enforced state machine, per-repo grounding bootstrapped by /spec:init (activation-verified via its deliverable manifest; session grounding included — path-scoped rules, a generated permissions allowlist, run + verify skills), executed-boot and skipped-test gates behind every review verdict, deterministic rule enforcement generated by /spec:enforce, and a closed feedback loop: release flushes host findings into version-stamped briefs, the shipped intake ledger returns fixed-upstream signals through /spec:doctor, and /spec:status — the glanceable derived where-am-I view (roadmap/spec status + skip anomalies) behind one deterministic script shared with doctor and plan's dependency preflight (brief dependencies parsed item-wise, so spec references in a Depends-on header surface as anomalies instead of phantom blockers), and plan's lock step captures session-discovered follow-up work as roadmap briefs before context dies; /spec:review now reconciles the full unscoped diff against the File Plan via scope-reconcile.js — out-of-plan changes are a mechanical hard finding and get reviewed, planned-but-untouched files are a mechanical soft finding, and /spec:build's Final gate surfaces the same signal advisory (rename exemption is conditional — an unplanned file's rename stays a hard finding); the review/release verdict word is now a derived value, never model prose — verdict.js reads a fresh per-iteration evidence manifest (Phase 0 legs append rows, re-executed each fix-delta iteration) plus the workflow return and disposition counts to produce the one word and ledger row printed/appended verbatim, gating the close step on its exit code; CI status flows through the shared ci-query.js wrapper as one more manifest leg (red blocks pre-panel, unavailable never blocks); /spec:release adopts the same derivation under a release profile with production as a required leg, wired on both its fail-fast STOP path and its Phase 4 success path; the ledger row itself is now complete — review rows carry runId (via --run-id, sourced from the wf-review Workflow invocation) plus manifest-derived smoke/testsSkipped, and release rows carry orchestrator-supplied milestone/briefs identity fields alongside manifest-derived staging/e2e/journeys/substrate/production, closing the gap between what review.md/release.md documented and what verdict.js actually emitted; `done` now carries a derived observation sub-state — observe-ci.js (built on ci-query.js) appends ancestry-validated stage:"observe" rows to the run ledger at the next /spec:status or /spec:review invocation (no daemon), spec-status.js renders done-unobserved/done-but-red and turns a red observation into the dashboard headline plus the --next top pick as a full oracle-shaped /spec:escape entry, and /spec:escape gains a red-observation derive path that reads the failing run and refuses to record against a spec the run doesn't implicate — closing the window where a green dashboard could coexist with a silently red run of the landed code; spec/INTAKE.md's accepted-findings table now carries a `Fix` column (`mechanism(<path>)` | `prose(<reason>)` | `—` | `pre-contract`) and a repeat-Category row may only close `prose(...)` with a stated impossibility reason — enforced every suite run by tests/intake/intake-discipline.test.js, so a recurring incident class can no longer get a second prose patch instead of a mechanism; observation now slims to a red alarm only (specs/20260807/01) — the done-unobserved certification half is retired by owner ruling (merge-back never pushes, so a historical close can never validate against a run and `pending` was a permanent nag), observe-ci.js checks the default branch's latest completed run once per invocation, attributes a red run by ancestry to the latest-closing implicated spec and clears it only via a later green run's ancestry over the same close commit, and spec-status.js derives observation as n/a|ok|red with nothing rendering for ok; the --pretty dashboard is also bottom-anchored — Roadmap, red-alarm lines, and anomalies print first, with 🎯 Next and the headline verdict line now the final two things on screen; spec-pipeline de-bloat (specs/20260807/03) — observe-ci.js's zero-consumer `--json` flag is deleted (unknown-flag path now covers it), observation.js's stale pending-era comments are corrected to the live winning-row/unobserved contract, the triply-stated autopilot SDK-import exception now lives once in `.claude/rules/spec-pipeline.md` § Review Checks with the other two copies reduced to citations, and scaffold-ledger.md's release-profile row gains an explicit two-consecutive-quarter zero-rows retire condition; claims registry (specs/20260807/04) — every blocking-consequence claim (`**hard**`, `hard finding`, uppercase `STOP`/`MUST`/`NEVER`/`ALWAYS`) in spec/commands, spec/doctrine, and spec/agents now carries an inline `<!-- enforcedBy: <path> -->` or `<!-- unenforced: <reason> -->` marker (grammar bound in shared.md § Doctrine Authoring); claims-lint.js is the sole derivation of the inventory and a dual line-count/orphan ratchet against claims-baseline.json (`--check`/`--json`/`--update-baseline`, wired as the `claims-lint` spec-paths key), gates tests/claims/claims-lint.test.js in npm test, and backs /spec:doctor check 18; review.md is the seed conversion (its 3 live bar-matching claims pointered, restated prose deduped to its named carriers); scaffold-ledger.md and .claude/rules/spec-pipeline.md § Review Checks (baseline-hunk bullet) and § Risk Tiers (claims-lint.js joins the sole-derivation T3 list) register the new gate; explore taste-channel hardening (specs/20260807/05) — /spec:genesis-explore Setup now hard-blocks on a render-capability precondition (Claude-in-Chrome or Playwright MCP), Phase 2 has the session author each position's starter tokens.css from the new spec/templates/design-positions.md field contract before the Sonnet builder fan-out (builders consume by role, append missing tokens, never alter an authored value — enforced by a pre-fan-out commit plus an additions-only `git diff` check), and Round 0's render→screenshot→critique loop is unconditional rather than browser-gated; scaffold-ledger.md's render-loop row is amended (not duplicated) to split gate-in-explore / advisory-elsewhere on the fired promote condition; /spec:enforce baseline carve-out (JJ-20260809, hearwell) — a verified enforcer's own write/fix mode may run ONCE over the tree to establish the baseline its new gate check requires (the `format` unwired-formatter case), conditioned on two-stage verify, pre-existing gate green before + full gate green after, and a `baselineRun` provenance entry in the enforcement manifest; the sole exception to enforce's never-edit-application-source rule, which otherwise stands; /spec:sketch model placement (2026-08-10 ruling on post-Fable-5 field evidence) — sketch mocks are authored by the session model itself in one sequential pass over the brief's gap surfaces, retiring the parallel per-surface Sonnet fan-out as a cross-surface drift source, with an overflow valve past 5 gap surfaces (one sequential Sonnet dispatch over the remainder, session-authored mocks cited as exemplars) and loop edits split taste-bearing-in-session vs mechanical-via-Sonnet; the genesis-design/design-stage half of the same ruling (registry-weighted canon, registry-grounded workers, session fidelity review at exit) is deferred to docs/roadmap/02-design-path-model-placement.md; design ITERATE handoff 🔗 lines now lead with the catalog's searchable keyword in backticks — the title's last segment + story name as space-separated words (e.g. Showcase Chat Thread), since Storybook's Find-components box matches words not slashed paths (verified live 2026-08-10) before the deep link (JJ-20260810 — URLs are painful to paste into an address bar); design-path model placement, genesis/design-stage half (2026-08-10 ruling, specs/20260810/01 — the sketch half shipped in v6.48.0) — /spec:genesis-design now seeds a component **vocabulary** into design/components.json alongside its base-primitive entries: commitment entries (name, purpose, optional boundaries) for every building block the ratified direction/doctrine/winner mocks commit the product to, structurally distinguished from landed entries by absent props/mockRefs; the new components-check.js (spec-paths components-check) is the manifest's schema authority, running fail-closed in genesis-design's commit step and advisory in the design driver's preflight; wf-design workers gain componentManifestPath and ground against the vocabulary exactly like tokens — a bound/imported/authored block fulfils each entry, never a lookalike, and a boundaries contradiction is a fork; /spec:design's two overlapping exit-time visual mechanisms (config-gated VISUAL step, advisory vision-review consult) are retired and replaced by one unified post-gate FIDELITY_REVIEW state (fidelity-reviewed mark, legacy visual-done mark satisfies it on resume) whose findings route into the iteration loop, never a gate; /spec:review's component-manifest leg now treats commitment entries as first-class in its near-duplicate comparison and in author-decision justifications; /spec:atlas's gap sweep adopts the sketch ruling's sequential, exemplar-grounded dispatch contract in place of parallel per-surface dispatch, recorded once in shared.md § Design Atlas as the single doctrine home covering both the sketch and atlas shapes; intake 2026-08-10 (UPWELL-20260810-01/-02, holistic dispositions) — plan.md's AC-shape rule now requires a cross-file Decision (producer → carrier → consumer → display) to pin the chain's terminal observable fed by the production path, with fixture-fed observations ruled non-terminal (the reported Wiring Plan artifact + wiring-matrix review leg was rejected as additive: the chain already lives in the Decision's prose, and the existing ac-matrix leg carries the tightened rule for free), and a resumed review whose branch moved on no longer diffs an unattributable blob — review.md Phase 0 derives the spec's last commit, detaches a frozen worktree when HEAD has moved, and passes wf-review the new frozenRoot arg so the panel reads and diffs the spec's own change while executed legs still run against the tree that ships; terminal-observable ACs (specs/20260810/02, closing the pipeline's dominant escape family — dead surfaces that typecheck/lint/test green but never execute or render nothing) — every Decision that promises a user-observable surface now owes a terminal-observable AC whose test asserts on the observable itself, reached through the spec's own in-repo route, fed by a fixture that is produced by the spec's own producer chain (view-model, assembler, defer-derivation) on realistic wire data, never a hand-authored props object — the anti-pattern is named invented-fixture liveness; the pure-UI TDD exemption is narrowed to appearance only at all four of its homes (build.md, the spec template's AC comment, shared.md § Design Canon, and init.md's generated Test Rules exemplar) — reachability is never exempt; /spec:plan's lock audit widens its existing Goal→Decision→red-capable-AC trace to Decision-level observable promises, the Phase 3 refuters gain one sentence treating a mocked in-repo hop between producer and terminal as top-severity, and /spec:build's `blocked` ruling row now requires a ruling that adds or changes an observable promise to add or update its terminal-observable AC in the same spec edit; no new script, section, or review leg — enforcement rides the existing AC↔test matrix, red-check, and skipped-test reconciliation gates, registered as one scaffold-ledger row; ratchet-mode architecture enforcers (specs/20260810/06) — /spec:enforce's category taxonomy grows two research-backed AI-signature smell classes, `duplication` and `cycle`, enforced as per-host ratchets: Phase 2 research requires candidates to support a baseline/known-violations mode, Phase 3 verify confirms the candidate goes green over its own established baseline, Phase 4 wiring establishes the baseline once and records it in the manifest enforcer entry as `baseline: { path, establishCmd }` with the gate invocation running in no-new-violations form (kept structurally distinct from the existing `baselineRun` write-mode carve-out, which edits source), and Phase 5's gap-hunt gains architecture-smell gaps as an explicit propose-never-auto-author class; the reserved taxonomy enum is now pinned byte-identical across its four homes (grounding-contract.md, enforce.md, wf-enforce.body.js CATEGORIES, doctor.md) by the new tests/enforce/taxonomy.test.js, closing a previously-unpinned drift surface; scaffold-ledger.md registers the ratchet mechanism with a promote/retire condition; per-SHA CI legs (specs/20260810/07, Prax stale-CI review-stop incident) — ci-query.js gains a `--commit <sha>` mode (exclusive with `--branch`, byte-identical normalization) so review's ci leg keys on the reviewed commit's own HEAD instead of the branch's latest run: a completed red run on the exact reviewed commit still hard-stops and derives GATE_RED, but a stale, unpushed, in-progress, or CI-less answer now records informationally and never blocks; `ci` stays in verdict.js's REVIEW_BLOCKING so that mapping is enforced by the sole derivation, not review.md prose; /spec:release gains the authoritative per-commit `ci` leg (RELEASE_LEGS grows to include it) with a bounded 30s/10-minute in-progress re-poll and a mandatory ⚠️ report line whenever CI never delivered a verdict on the release commit; /spec:doctor gains check 19 (advisory) verifying the host's CI workflow actually invokes the configured gateCommand, closing the local-green/CI-red drift class at its root; observe-ci.js's branch-latest keying is untouched (it answers a different question — the trunk's post-merge alarm, never verdict.js's input); command-consistency fix wave (conflicts) (specs/20260810/08) — twelve command-surface audit findings resolved to one authoritative behavior each: plan.md's T2 tier step gates on shared.md § Pipeline Entry (delegation/durability only, else STOP direct-work); review.md splits {root} (Phase 0, working tree under review) from a Phase-4-only {mainRoot} (resolved via {mergeBack} root --worktree before Phase 4 step 1) so merge-back's eleven main-tree consumers never see a worktree path, and corrects its build_base attribution to /git:enter-worktree; build.md's in-place Phase 0 step 4 now writes a durable diff_base: frontmatter field (spec.md template gains the commented field) that review.md's step 1 recovery order consumes between build_base and the branch-name fallback; doctor.md check 11 re-keys stale-implementing to the derived spec/<stem> build branch (build_base-conditional, in-place builds skipped) and adds superseded to the status enum, while check 12 raises its prose-leak threshold to ~1000 chars and enumerates fast-path build/escape/release row exemptions alongside observe; release.md states plainly that releasing is user-invoked by design, never suggested by Next pointers; init.md Phase 6 gains a pending/unrecognized-design genesis arm (warn, proceed, no design block, names /spec:genesis-design); genesis-design.md drops its self-contradicting "Fable or Opus" header seat claim (Opus, matching its own Phase 4) and its terminal Next pointer now routes through /spec:atlas before /spec:init
